items.name: InstrumentKind
items.summary: The identifier of a group of instruments that all perform the same function.

items.name: Instrument
items.summary: Describes the properties of an instrument at creation, used for filtering in views. This is utilized in the `with_view` methods on `MeterProviderBuilder` to customize metric output.

items.name: Stream
items.summary: Describes the stream of data an instrument produces. Used in `with_view` methods on `MeterProviderBuilder` to customize the metric output.

methods.name: builder
methods.summary: Create a new stream builder with default values.

items.name: StreamBuilder
items.summary: A builder for creating Stream objects.

methods.name: build
methods.summary: Build a new Stream instance using the configuration in this builder.

methods.name: with_aggregation
methods.summary: Set the stream aggregation. This is used to customize the aggregation. If not set, the default aggregation based on the instrument kind will be used.

methods.name: with_allowed_attribute_keys
methods.signature: fn with_allowed_attribute_keys(self, attribute_keys: impl IntoIterator<Item = Key>) -> Self
methods.summary: Set the stream allowed attribute keys.

methods.name: with_cardinality_limit
methods.summary: Set the stream cardinality limit. If this is not set, the default limit of 2000 will be used.

methods.name: with_description
methods.signature: fn with_description(self, description: impl Into<Cow<'static, str>>) -> Self
methods.summary: Set the stream description. If this is not set, description provided while creating the instrument will be used.

methods.name: with_name
methods.signature: fn with_name(self, name: impl Into<Cow<'static, str>>) -> Self
methods.summary: Set the stream name. If this is not set, name provide while creating the instrument will be used.

methods.name: with_unit
methods.signature: fn with_unit(self, unit: impl Into<Cow<'static, str>>) -> Self
methods.summary: Set the stream unit. If this is not set, unit provided while creating the instrument will be used.
